entries.zh: 说清楚；阐明（把话讲明白）
entries.en: to speak clearly; to explain plainly
entries.notes: H 首字疑为「闡」（形近聞/開），M chiēn bīng 与「阐明」音义相合，故从「说清楚」解。

entries.en: to speak loudly; to shout
to speak little; to hold one's tongue; to endure
entries.notes: M lun chuy 即「忍口」，与「少言、隐忍」相合；L 末词有连笔，sufrir 取「忍受」义。

entries.en: to speak the Mandarin (northerners') language
entries.notes: 「北客」指北方人／官话使用者；M 栏连笔严重难辨，R 栏残损不可用，依 L、H 定夺。

entries.en: to speak the truth; to speak from the heart
entries.notes: M pēng sīm tã 即「凭心呾」；R 栏末有 cierto ablar，可证「说真话」义；L 末词词界不清。

entries.en: to speak rudely; to speak discourteously
entries.notes: H 首字（比/北）与 M 连笔俱有疑，依 L「descortesmente」定夺。

entries.en: to speak well and fittingly; to speak flawlessly
entries.notes: M tā oe ca nūỹ 逐字对「呾語完全」，与 bien conveniencia 之合宜、周全义相合；H 首字有疑。

entries.en: to talk nonsense; to speak empty words
entries.notes: L 名词部分连笔难辨（疑为 necedades），仅据 H「空庵」／M cong ám 推为「空言」，义未定。

entries.en: to speak truthfully; to state the facts
to speak according to justice; to speak justly
to report to a superior; to speak with leave
entries.notes: 「稟告」为下对上陈报，即须获准方可进言之义。

entries.en: to have no choice but to speak; to be obliged to say
entries.notes: L 词界不清（疑 amas no poder）；H「不得不然」与 M put tēg put xiēn 逐字相合，据此定夺。

entries.en: to speak of something; to bring up a matter
entries.notes: H 首字疑（启/诡），M guey cō 近「启告」。

entries.en: [original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 连笔不可辨，H 崎峣（疑岐）与 M gūy qviaú 未能成义，不作定解。

entries.en: to talk too much; to be garrulous
entries.notes: H 疑为「滑」（口滑＝油嘴多话），与 demasiado 合；然 M cūi 作平声近「渭」，二字未尽合。

entries.zh: 彼此说话；互相交谈（西语疑为带怒而言）
entries.en: to speak to one another; to talk among themselves (angrily)
entries.notes: L 连笔难辨（tenojado 疑为 enojado）；H「冊共誰說」与 M che cang chuy sue 未能确合，义不定。

entries.zh: 窃窃私语；彼此低声絮语
entries.en: to whisper to one another; to mutter among themselves
entries.notes: L 原有 murmurando 被划删；H 蟙蟙为记音符，M chy chy 合「唧唧」私语之声。

entries.en: to inquire; to ask and find out
entries.notes: L 缩写 in quiendo 疑为 inquiriendo；H 查着 与 M che tīo 相合，即「查问、查明」。

entries.en: to continue speaking; to speak in sequence
entries.notes: L 插注（por metamram 等）连笔难辨；H 接續／M tsiap-siok 义尚明。

entries.en: to speak softly; to speak in a low voice
to speak in a soft voice; to lower one's voice
to speak in a low voice; to whisper
entries.notes: L 末词疑为 pasito（小声地）；H 細聲与 M sey sia 相符。
